subject: Re: Repeated latency spikes affecting transaction processing - pilot and escalation
messages:
From: Kate Zimmer <kate@cloudbank.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: support@cloudbank.com
Date: 2027-05-01T09:14:00Z
Subject: Repeated latency spikes affecting transaction processing — urgent

Kimberly,

Over the last two weeks we've seen repeated latency spikes during our morning settlement window (between 02:00-04:00 UTC) that are directly impacting transaction throughput. We've logged several occurrences where tail latency exceeded 2.5s and a small number of timeouts. This is affecting our reconciliation batch and causing downstream retries in our ledger service.

I've attached a small sample of traces and a consolidated log (cloudbank_latency_log_20270428.zip) for your SREs. Our renewal is up in June and the leadership team is asking whether a different support path / SLA profile is necessary for production stability. We need clarity on:
- Short-term mitigations to stabilize morning peak
- Whether a dedicated or prioritized pool is an option and the expected lead time
- What SLA uplift (availability and latency SLOs) would look like and any credit calculations

Procurement (procure@cloudbank.com) is copied since they'll likely want an amendment if we move tiers.

—Kate
Kate Zimmer
Head of Payments & Integrations
CloudBank Solutions
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Kate Zimmer <kate@cloudbank.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Repeated latency spikes affecting transaction processing — urgent

Kate — thanks for the detailed logs and the heads-up. I’m really sorry you’ve been hit by this during a critical window. I ran the attachment quickly and shared it with our infra leads.

Short answers up front:
- We can stand up a short dedicated pilot (reserved pool) to run your morning batch on isolated capacity; typical lead time is 2–4 weeks depending on region and capacity commitments.
- We can commit to a higher SLO during the pilot (targeting 99.95% availability for the specified window) and provide a clear credit formula if SLOs are missed.
- Immediate mitigations: enable aggressive prefix-KV caching for your settlement prefixes and adjust batching thresholds to reduce tail latency while we investigate kernel-level hotspots. Our infra team will coordinate the tuning.

I’ve attached our historical SLA report (sla_history_CloudBank_Q1.pdf) for context and a pilot scope draft (pilot_scope_draft_v1.docx). Rishi — can you and Marcus review proposed commercial options below and confirm feasibility for a 3-month reserved pilot with an option to convert to Dedicated?

Next step: I propose a 30-minute call tomorrow to align on timing and which team to onboard first.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Director, Account Sales | Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T08:22:00Z
Subject: Internal: CloudBank — pilot commercial proposal / credits

Kim / Marcus — quick internal note after reviewing the logs and the SLA history. Summary and proposal:

Summary of findings (reading from Kim’s attachments):
- Spikes coincide with larger-than-usual batch windows; KV cache warmups and some kernel-level queuing at that sequence length appear to be amplifying tail latency.
- No single-change incident found in infra but repeated pattern suggests capacity interference.

Commercial proposal (draft):
1) 12-week dedicated pilot: reserved GPU pool sized for their peak batch throughput, priority routing for settlement prefixes.
2) Target SLO during pilot: 99.95% availability for 02:00-04:30 UTC window, 95th/99th token-latency targets documented.
3) Credit formula: credits equal to (missed % points) * 10% of that month’s reserved fee, capped at 50% for the month.
4) Option to convert to Dedicated (12-month committed) within 30 days of pilot completion with a pre-agreed discount tier.

Operational caveats: 2–4 week implementation lead time; onboarding support time billed as engineering hours (we can absorb up to 40 hours during pilot at no charge).

I’ll draft a short HubSpot deal and a one-page amendment for Procurement. Draft deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890

-Marking deal id R-20270509-CB if we proceed.

-Rishi
Head of Field Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Kate Zimmer <kate@cloudbank.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@cloudbank.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T13:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Repeated latency spikes affecting transaction processing — urgent

Thanks, Kim and Rishi. The plan sounds reasonable and faster than I expected — appreciate that. A few clarifications from our side before Procurement engages formally:

- We need the pilot SLO documented in the amendment with a clear measurement window and the monitoring signals you’ll use (we use Datadog and can add your tracing headers).
- The credit formula should include an example calculation in the doc so our CFO can see the impact.
- Lead time: CloudBank prefers a hard 3-week start if possible; our busiest settlement month is June so we'd like the pilot in May if we can.

Procurement: please let us know what contract packaging you need to review (MSA amendment, PO, or separate statement).

If you can get a one-page amendment + example credit calc over to Procure this week, we’ll fast-track.

—Kate
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Kate Zimmer <kate@cloudbank.com>, Procurement <procure@cloudbank.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T14:32:00Z
Subject: Re: Repeated latency spikes affecting transaction processing — pilot & amendment (doc + next steps)

Kate / Team — following up with the materials you requested. Apologies for the short delay; we validated a minor kernel tweak with the infra team before sending the amendment so the example calc is representative.

What’s attached:
- pilot_scope_draft_v1.docx (scope + runbook + monitoring signals we’ll capture)
- sla_history_CloudBank_Q1.pdf (historical availability)
- example_credit_calc.pdf (walkthrough with sample months and numbers)

Key points:
- We can start onboarding the week of 2027-05-17 to hit your 3-week target; final start is subject to a short checklist (IP allowlist, pubkey exchange, Datadog header config).
- Pilot SLO: 99.95% availability during 02:00–04:30 UTC; we’ll publish the calculation window and use both our internal traces and your Datadog metrics for verification.
- Credit formula: (SLO_target - Observed_SLO)% * 10% * monthly_reserved_fee, capped at 50% for the month; example provided in the calc doc.
- On conversion: if CloudBank elects to convert to a 12-month Dedicated commitment within 30 days of pilot completion, we’ll honor a 12% discount on the committed rate (pre-negotiated).

Next steps:
1) Procurement to confirm preferred contract flow (MSA amendment w/ PO vs signed SOW). DocuSign link for MSA amendment will be shared once Procure confirms — placeholder: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/MSA-amendment-R-20270509
2) Technical kickoff: proposed 45-minute call with infra team on 2027-05-18.
3) Commercial: Rishi to open the HubSpot opportunity and attach final one-page amendment.

If that looks good I’ll schedule the kickoff and loop in our Eng reliability lead.

Thanks — Kim

Kimberly Park
Senior Director, Account Sales | Redwood Inference
